question: How many patients will Mendoza's Ministry of Health have confirmed as infected with *Serratia marcescens* in the Hospital Privado outbreak as of November 13, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Status quo: ministry figure of 5 lab-confirmed patients (Oct 27-30: 10 analysed, 5 confirmed, 3 suspected, 2 discarded; La Nacion Oct 30 variant gives 3 discarded and 2 deaths under study). No newer update found through Nov 2. Operating rooms closed since Oct 21, so no new exposures; most incubation windows have passed. Upside comes from the pending suspected cases and retrospective case-finding; the count rose 4->5 by adding a September surgery patient after the fact. Deaths under study may never get a microbiological confirmation. Downside requires reclassifying a confirmed case (unlikely). No prediction market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.
calls.dossier:
- Oct 21 2026: provincial alert activated; ORs at Hospital Privado de Mendoza closed preventively (prensa.mendoza.gob.ar). No new surgical exposures there since.
- Oct 24: ministry reported 4 confirmed S. marcescens patients, 2 dead, ~6 more under observation (La Nacion, MDZ Oct 24).
- Oct 26: director of epidemiology Falaschi: 8 under follow-up, not all confirmed; outbreak expansion ruled out; OR contamination is the main hypothesis (La Nacion Oct 26).
- Oct 27-28: 5th case confirmed (a patient operated in September, found retrospectively). 10 analysed: 5 confirmed (3 meningitis in CSF, 1 blood, 1 surgical site), 3 suspected, 2 discarded (Diario Uno, Sitio Andino, Los Andes, Prensa Mercosur).
- Oct 28: La Nacion reported 2 possible new cases under analysis that would bring the total to 7 if confirmed (press, not ministry).
- Oct 29: 2 more deaths under investigation, pending microbiological confirmation (Infobae, La Arena).
- Oct 30 (La Nacion): 5 confirmed, 2 dead among them; 2 deaths under study; 3 discarded; 10 under study in total. Conflicts slightly with the earlier 3-suspected/2-discarded split.
- Searched Oct 31-Nov 2 for any 6th confirmation or new ministry update: none found.
- Status quo: 5 confirmed.
- Resolution: resolves off the Mendoza Ministerio de Salud y Deportes' latest stated lab-confirmed patient count (mendoza.gov.ar statement governs), not press speculation or hospital figures.
- Event window: last ministry statement on or before Nov 13 2026 (local); as of Nov 2, about 10 of the ~12 remaining days are still ahead.
- Pending pool: 3-5 patients (suspected cases plus deaths under study; overlap unclear). Dead patients may lack samples for confirmation.
- No prediction market found.
calls.reference_class: Point-source nosocomial Serratia outbreaks after the source is shut down (closed ORs): confirmed counts usually rise only by a fraction of the pending suspected pool within ~2 weeks
